trainable: Two full-resolution RGB perturbations only; model and learned basis a remain fixed
resize: Exact saved-8bit-PNG/Pillow bicubic forward; torch antialiased bicubic surrogate gradient
loss: Answer-plus-EOS mean token CE; matched pair weight 0.5; each of five negative conditions weight 0.1
prompt: Natural question only; no added permission or output-format instructions; native model chat template
sampling: Shuffle all 60 questions without replacement each cycle; all six conditions per update; normal/blank/noise vary by schedule
checkpoint: Every 50 steps and step1; latest optimizer state; best images by development balanced accuracy
development: 2 historical development questions, all validation normals and all 3 blank values, plus 2 noise seeds each; saved-PNG generation at step0,1,and every100
selection: Maximize 0.5*authorized exact-match + 0.5*mean(per-negative-condition exact refusal); tie break lower development weighted CE, then earlier step
final_evaluation: Selected and final images on all60 training questions +10 historical test questions; all4 held-out normal negatives, all3 blank values,2 fresh noise seeds; saved-PNG free generation
historical_test_scope: Previously analyzed test questions; no new blind test claim. No test-based checkpoint selection.
leakage_metric: Raw substring 920051; also whitespace-normalized substring; preserve complete generated answers
scope: One student card, one initialization/seed; natural/blank/noise distractors; no other-card key-pair safety or cross-image generalization claim
